File Information
Collection: Docker Store API (v1)
Collection Description
E-commerce modular monolith: users, products, orders, notifications. How to run: 1. Start the project: docker compose up --build -d (after pulling a change to db/init.sql, reset the database first: docker compose down -v) 2. If you changed PORT, ADMIN_EMAIL or ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env, update the collection variables host, adminEmail, adminPassword. 3. Image uploads: in Postman Settings > General > Working directory, choose the project folder docs/test-files (or pick docs/test-files/sample-product.png by hand in the "image" field of the upload requests). 4. Run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner). Every request has tests. Folder 4 is the access-control proof: another customer's order, actions outside your role, missing and forged tokens are all rejected. Folder 8 shows the login attempt limit, folder 9 the notifications. The collection registers fresh accounts on every run, so it can be run again without a reset.
